newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PZU to pay PLN 320 mln in flood damages.
newsitem.headline: Polish PZU to pay PLN 320 mln in flood damages.

text.p: State-owned insurer PZU SA has sufficient funds to cover the expected 320 million zlotys in flood damages after floods inundated more than 4,000 sq km of southern Poland, PZU said in a statement.
"At present, PZU has at its disposal financial resources amounting to 350 million zlotys, which may be used at any time for payments of damage caused by the flood," the company said.
The firm said on Thursday its payments for the damage would amount to some 320 million zlotys, which would trigger a drop in financial results, but would not undermine its liquidity.
"These resources are located in short-term deposits, such as T-bills, companies' bonds, and repo transactions on treasury bonds and bills," the statement said.
In June 1997, PZU reported its net profit reaching 204.9 million zlotys after the first quarter of the year. Its losses amounted to 169.7 million zlotys in 1996.
